name: gumroad-mcp
description: Cloudflare Worker exposing the Gumroad API v2 to Claude as an MCP server. Bearer-protected /mcp endpoint, token held as a Worker secret.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/gumroad.js && node --check src/mcp.js && node --check src/tools.js

GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Your Gumroad account access token. Gumroad, Settings, Advanced, Applications.

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: A long random string. Claude and Notion present this as a bearer token to reach /mcp. Keep a copy.
